name: csengine-support
description: Projects made on Critical Success Engine: @cse/* imports resolve to the engine's sources, with types, completion and go to definition.

cse.enginePath.markdownDescription: The engine's repository (the folder that holds `src/CSEngine`). Imports of `@cse/core`, `@cse/ui` and the like in your projects then resolve to the engine's sources. Leave empty inside the repository itself: the engine around the file is used.
